project.name: Billing Record
project.tagline: Record income and expenses from a photo of a bank slip or bill.

skipped.reason: Code conventions, not useful to the owner.

text: A personal web app for one person to keep track of money coming in and going out.
You photograph a bill or upload a bank slip, check what the app read from it, and save it.

stories.want: to upload a bank slip image and get a filled-in record I can confirm in one click
stories.so: I do not have to type the details

stories.want: to export all my records to a CSV file
stories.so: I have a backup I can open in Excel

open_questions: Which currencies do you use besides Thai baht?
